hangar.compute.v1alpha1.NodeResources.description: NodeResources is an amount of compute. Each field is a quantity in Kubernetes syntax; empty means the node does not report it.

hangar.compute.v1alpha1.NodeSpec.description: NodeSpec is how the platform wants the node used.

unschedulable.description: Keeps the scheduler from placing new machines on the node. Machines already there keep running.

hangar.compute.v1alpha1.NodeStatus.description: NodeStatus is what the node agent reports, plus the Ready condition the apiserver turns Unknown when the reports stop. The apiserver judges silence by when it received reports, on its own clock, never by last_heartbeat_time.

allocatable.description: What is left for machines after the host's own needs.

ipv6Prefix.description: The host's public IPv6 prefix, such as "2001:db8:0:1::/64", from which each machine interface on the node gets a /128; empty when the host has none, and its machines then have no IPv6.

lastHeartbeatTime.description: When the agent last reported, by the agent's clock.

placement.description: The host's hardware, which the status of each Container and VirtualMachine on the node carries.

sharedIpv4.description: The host's shared IPv4 address, such as "198.51.100.3", which its machines' IPv4 leaves as and where PortForwards to them are open; empty when the host has none, and PortForwards to its machines open nowhere.

hangar.compute.v1alpha1.Placement.description: Placement describes the hardware of a machine's host, never its load; every tenant with a machine on the node reads it. Fields are at most 64 printable characters. See docs/decisions/machine-placement.md.

chassis.description: Names the host's chassis, a DNS-1123 label such as "generic-1u-2x-u2"; a client draws one it does not know, or none, as a generic server.

cpuGeneration.description: The CPU's microarchitecture and code name, such as "Example Gen 3": known to the node agent for the CPUs it has a name for, or from the node's configuration.

cpuModel.description: The CPU as the host names it, without its core count, such as "Example CPU 1000".

memory.description: The kind of the host's memory, never its size, such as "DDR4-3200 ECC".

network.description: The host's Ethernet ports by the most speed each supports, never its link's, such as "2 × 10 GbE".

region.description: The region the host is in, such as "region-1", from the node's configuration.

site.description: The site within the region, such as a datacenter's name "site-a", from the node's configuration.

storage.description: The host's disks by kind, such as "2 × NVMe SSD".

hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: Node is a host that runs machines. The apiserver creates one for each node agent it is configured to accept; the agent reports its status. Only the system writes nodes, and only platform administrators read them.
title: Node
